tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_empty
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a number with a decimal point but no trailing fraction digits using json_document::parse.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_single
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a number with exactly one fraction digit using json_document::parse.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_short_vector
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a number with a short fraction (fewer than 16 digits) followed by a comma.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_exactly_sixteen
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction containing exactly 16 digits to test the exact block boundary of the SSE2 optimization.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_seventeen
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction containing 17 digits to test a fraction crossing the 16-byte block boundary.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_long
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a long fraction containing 32 digits, spanning multiple 16-byte blocks.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_with_exponent
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction followed by scientific notation exponent specifier.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_capital_exponent
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction followed by a capital exponent indicator.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_terminated_by_bracket
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a number fraction directly terminated by a closing array bracket.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_terminated_by_brace
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fractional number placed as an object value and terminated by a closing object brace.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_terminated_by_comma
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fractional number inside an array followed by a comma separator.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_terminated_by_colon
tests.intent: Probes parsing of an invalid structure where a fractional number is directly followed by a colon.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_terminated_by_whitespace
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fractional number terminated by various whitespace characters.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_multiple_in_array
tests.intent: Probes parsing of multiple varying-length fractional numbers in a single array container.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_accept
tests.intent: Probes the accept() validation API on input containing various fraction lengths.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_read_method
tests.intent: Probes the instance read() method on a json_document object with a fraction containing input.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_load_buffer
tests.intent: Probes loading raw byte buffers containing fractional numbers via json_document::load.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_copy_construction
tests.intent: Probes copy construction of a json_document containing parsed fraction inputs.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_move_assignment
tests.intent: Probes move assignment operator on a json_document holding fractional number views.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_vector_bytes
tests.intent: Probes parsing from a std::vector<std::uint8_t> containing a fractional number document.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Probes parsing of an extremely long fraction (greater than 16 digits) to force the SSE2 vector loop and non-zero mask exit path inside skip_fraction_digits.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction length that is a multiple of 16 digits followed immediately by a terminator character, exercising the loop termination and skip_digits_tail fallback.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a fraction containing exactly 15 digits (just under the 16-byte SSE2 vector width) to ensure skip_fraction_digits falls straight through to skip_digits_tail.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Probes parsing of multiple distinct numbers with varying fraction lengths in a single document using the accept method to execute skip_fraction_digits across multiple tokens.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Probes loading a binary byte buffer containing a 20-digit fraction number via basic_json_document::load to exercise skip_fraction_digits from a raw pointer buffer interface.

tests.name: json_view_fraction_digits_copy_construction_fixed
tests.intent: Probes copy construction of a json_document containing parsed fraction inputs.
